name: Global Corporate & Patent Intelligence - watchlist matches

nodes.name: Schedule Trigger
nodes.notes: Runs once a day at 06:00 (workflow timezone). Change the interval to taste: every run that delivers rows is billed.

nodes.name: Build run input
nodes.notes: Edit CONFIG at the top: sources, delta mode, per-source row limit, watchlist, state namespace. A watchlist that cleans down to nothing stops the workflow instead of running unfiltered.

nodes.name: Start Apify run
nodes.notes: Replace YOUR_APIFY_USERNAME with the Apify account that published the Actor. maxTotalChargeUsd is the hard spending cap for this run in USD: edit it here. Do NOT enable Retry On Fail on this node: a retried POST can start a second billable run.

nodes.name: Run still going?
nodes.notes: True (no final status yet: not SUCCEEDED, FAILED, TIMED-OUT or ABORTED, and fewer than 120 polls so far) goes back to the Wait node; False leaves the loop and reads the dataset. At 30 s per poll the loop waits at most 60 minutes; a run still going after that is read as it stands and keeps running on Apify under its spending cap.

nodes.name: Deliver matches downstream
nodes.notes: Connect your own nodes here (Slack, email, a ticket, a webhook). Each item is one delivered record whose is_watchlist_match is true.
